purpose: Replace repeated prompt-level dialogue repair with a production pipeline: human-positive in-project prose anchor for the fresh writer, plus a post-freeze mechanical-dialogue blocker that the writer never sees.
design: writer sees scene facts plus a small human-positive in-project prose anchor
writer does not see anti-AI or mechanical-dialogue rules
deterministic tripwire catches obvious short-turn / Q&A adjacency ladders
semantic blocker evaluates whether speech is mainly exact response completion rather than character-owned action/priority
if either blocker fires, the whole candidate is rejected; no local dialogue patching
a replacement candidate, if authorized, must come from a genuinely fresh writer context with no blocker feedback
forbidden: expose blocker rules to the prose writer
repair blocked dialogue locally and resubmit as the same candidate
treat deterministic metrics as sufficient proof of literary quality
copy external copyrighted prose into the writer anchor
next_action: Create PHASE395_GATED_FRESH_WRITER_TO_REPO_V1. Fresh writer stores an unseen candidate directly in repository inbox; coordinator freezes and runs both blocker layers before any prose is shown to the user.
